correctness.rationale: The complete-bipartite statement follows from the exact Laplacian spectral projectors and positive factorizations of the three off-diagonal orbit values; stochasticity follows from the zero Laplacian mode. For P4, all rational-entry denominators are positive, every numerator except the endpoint-neighbor orbit is manifestly nonnegative, and that orbit changes sign at the unique positive root of a one-sign-change quartic. The exact h=12 witness was replayed from the packaged checker.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an exact structural preservation law for a standard fourth-order A-stable semigroup approximant on a canonical infinite family of network generators, together with an exact minimal graph-size obstruction. It separates unconditional graph-protected positivity from known general Padé failures and from the lower-order Crank--Nicolson threshold phenomenon.
